tools.name: run_employer_of
tools.description:
The legal entity that employs an employee, with its legal form, country and status.

Use when: Which company, legal entity or subsidiary employs a person, who the employer under the employment contract is, in which country. Employees only; an external person has no employer in the graph. Not for who owns the employer, and not for the unit a person works in.

Examples:
- Which legal entity employs this person?
- In which country is the employer of this employee registered?

person.description: The employee whose employer is asked for. An entity of class ppl:Employee: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_members_of_unit
tools.description:
People holding a position in a unit or in any unit below it, with the position and its unit.

Use when: Who works in a department or team, who belongs to a unit including its sub-units, headcount or staffing of a unit, who sits in which position of a unit. Lists holders of positions, so a position nobody holds does not appear; use vacant_positions for those. Not for the reporting line of one position.

Examples:
- Who works in the engineering department, including its teams?
- Which people hold a position in this team?

unit.description: The department or team to list; its sub-units are included. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_missing_required_trainings
tools.description:
Trainings that the holders of positions in a unit must still complete, per person.

Use when: Which trainings are outstanding, overdue or not yet completed in a department or team, who still has to complete a required training, training gaps or compliance of a unit including its sub-units. A training is required through the role a position carries. Answers per unit, not for one person's full list of required trainings.

Examples:
- Which required trainings are still open for the people of the infrastructure department?
- Who in this team has not completed all trainings their role requires?

unit.description: The department or team to check; its sub-units are included. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_policies_for_unit
tools.description:
Policies that bind a unit, directly or through a unit above it, with status and dates.

Use when: Which policies apply to a department or team, which rules a unit is bound by, whether a policy is in force or due for review. A policy that applies to a unit binds the units below it too, so policies of parent units are included. Not for the processes a policy governs or for the text of a policy.

Examples:
- Which policies is the finance department bound by?
- Which policies apply to this team, including those of its department?

unit.description: The department or team whose policies are listed. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_reporting_chain
tools.description:
The positions a position reports to, up to the top, nearest first, with their current holders.

Use when: Who is the manager or boss of a position, whom a position reports to, the escalation path or chain of command up to the top of the org chart. Walks the reporting line of one position, not the people who report to it. A position nobody holds shows an empty holder.

Examples:
- Whom does this position report to, all the way up?
- Who is the manager of this position?

position.description: The position whose reporting line is walked. An entity of class org:Position: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_required_trainings
tools.description:
Every training the given people need through the roles of their positions, and whether they did it.

Use when: Which trainings a person (or several people) needs, has completed or still lacks, through which position and role a training is required, and when it was completed. One person's full training list; for the gaps of a whole department or team use missing_required_trainings.

Examples:
- Which trainings does this employee need, and which are done?

person.description: The people to check; repeat the parameter for several. An entity of class ppl:Person: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_shareholders_of
tools.description:
Who holds stakes in the given legal entities, with the percent of each stake and its date.

Use when: Who owns a legal entity or subsidiary, the shareholders and their percentages, whether a holder owns more than half (the parent company), and which stakes are recorded at all. Not for what an entity itself owns.

Examples:
- Who owns this company, and is there a parent company?

entity.description: The legal entities whose shareholders are asked for; repeat the parameter for several. An entity of class leg:LegalEntity: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_training_completions
tools.description:
Who completed which of the given trainings since a date.

Use when: Completion records of named trainings, certificates earned in a period.

Examples:
- Who completed the safety or the security training this year? Input: {"since": "2026-01-01", "titles": ["Safety", "Security"]}

titles.description: Titles of the trainings to include.

since.description: Only completions on or after this date.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_vacant_positions
tools.description:
Positions of a unit or of any unit below it that nobody holds, active or still planned.

Use when: Which positions are open, vacant or unfilled in a department or team, where hiring is needed, staffing gaps of a unit including its sub-units. Abolished positions are left out; the status column tells an open position from a planned one. Not for who holds the filled positions; use members_of_unit for that.

Examples:
- Which positions in the engineering department are currently vacant?
- Where do we still have open positions in this team?

unit.description: The department or team to check; its sub-units are included. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: do_assign_position
tools.description:
Staff a vacant position from a date; a person joins a unit by holding one of its positions.

Use when: Someone starts in, joins, takes over or is appointed to a job, a role in the org chart or a unit; staffing a vacant position. Not for replacing the current holder: use hand_over_position.

Examples:
- The new recruiter starts as the support lead on the first of March.

person.description: Who takes over the position. An entity of class ppl:Person: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

position.description: The vacant position. An entity of class org:Position: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_reason.description: Why this change is made; recorded in the audit trail.

_dry_run.description: Check the preconditions and report what would change; nothing is written.

tools.name: do_hand_over_position
tools.description:
Replace the current holder of a position by another person, from a date.

Use when: A position that somebody holds gets a new holder: succession, a swap, a handover. Not for staffing a vacant position: use assign_position.

Examples:
- The head of the support team hands the lead position over to a colleague.

position.description: The position that changes hands. An entity of class org:Position: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

person.description: The new holder. An entity of class ppl:Person: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

since.description: Date the new holder takes over.

_reason.description: Why this change is made; recorded in the audit trail.

_dry_run.description: Check the preconditions and report what would change; nothing is written.

tools.name: do_offboard_employee
tools.description:
Record that an employee has left; remove their positions and employer first.

Use when: An employee leaves the company or their employment ends. Removes the positions they hold and their employer link, then moves the employee to the state left.

Examples:
- A colleague from the sales team left the company at the end of the month.

employee.description: The employee who leaves. An entity of class ppl:Employee: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_reason.description: Why this change is made; recorded in the audit trail. Required for this action.

_dry_run.description: Check the preconditions and report what would change; nothing is written.

tools.name: view_legacy_unit_overview
tools.description:
The old team overview; use unit_overview.

Deprecated; use view_unit_overview.

Use when: Replaced by unit_overview; kept until the last reader has moved.

_entity.description: The entity to show. An entity of class org:Team: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

tools.name: view_members_report
tools.description:
The people of one department, from the published function.

Use when: Who works in a department including its teams, as a set view with a reference parameter.

unit.description: The department to report on. An entity of class org:Department: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_cursor.description: The next of the previous page of this view, with the same parameters; leave it out for the first page.

_page_bytes.description: Page size in bytes; the view's own size, else 12288.

tools.name: view_org_catalog
tools.description:
Every unit, position and person with their keys and relations, for catalog renderers.

Use when: Render or export the organisation as a whole, one listing per kind of thing; not for one entity (use graph view REF).

since.description: Only trainings completed on or after this date.

_cursor.description: The next of the previous page of this view, with the same parameters; leave it out for the first page.

_page_bytes.description: Page size in bytes; the view's own size, else 12288.

tools.name: view_position_overview
tools.description:
A position with its unit, its holder and the positions that report to it.

Use when: Who holds a position, where it sits in the org chart and who reports to it. Local relation names are accepted and stored as CURIEs.

_entity.description: The entity to show. An entity of class org:Position: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

tools.name: view_tasks_by_state
tools.description:
The tasks in one state that are due before a day, oldest first.

Use when: Which tasks are open, in progress or done, and which are overdue.

Examples:
- Which tasks are still open this quarter? Input: {"before": "2026-04-01", "status": "open"}

status.description: Lifecycle state of the tasks to list.

before.description: Only tasks due before this day.

_cursor.description: The next of the previous page of this view, with the same parameters; leave it out for the first page.

_page_bytes.description: Page size in bytes; the view's own size, else 12288.

tools.name: view_unit_overview
tools.description:
A unit with its cost center, its positions in a state and who holds them.

Use when: What a department or team is about: where it sits, what it costs, which positions it has in a given state and who holds them, which policies bind it.

Examples:
- Which active positions does the engineering department have? Input: {"status": "active"}

_entity.description: The entity to show. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the positions to list.
